    import asyncio
    from pylabrobot.liquid_handling import LiquidHandler
    from pylabrobot.liquid_handling.backends import (
    LiquidHandlerChatterboxBackend,  # FIXED: was deprecated ChatterBoxBackend
    )


    async def protocol(lh: LiquidHandler):
    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.
    Sample Transfer & Reagent Addition Workflow.

    Args:
        lh (LiquidHandler): The liquid handler instance for performing operations
    """

    # =========================================================
    # Retrieve pre-configured deck resources
    # =========================================================
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Protocol parameters ---
    sample_volume = 40    # uL transferred per sample (within 50 uL tip capacity)
    reagent_volume = 10   # uL reagent added per destination well
    mix_volume = 45       # uL mixing volume (safe margin below tip capacity)
    num_samples = 8       # process wells A1-A8 of each plate

    # =========================================================
    # Step 1: Transfer samples (source -> destination)
    # =========================================================
    # Each sample gets a fresh tip from row A of the tip rack to
    # prevent cross-contamination between samples.
    for i in range(num_samples):
        source_well = source_plate[f"A{i + 1}"]
        dest_well = destination_plate[f"A{i + 1}"]
        tip_well = tip_rack[f"A{i + 1}"]

        # Pick up a fresh tip for this sample
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_well)

        # Aspirate sample from the source plate
        await lh.aspirate(source_well, vols=[sample_volume])

        # Dispense sample into the matching destination well
        await lh.dispense(dest_well, vols=[sample_volume])

        # Return the used tip to its original rack position
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_well)

    # =========================================================
    # Step 2: Add reagent and mix in destination wells
    # =========================================================
    # Reagent is drawn from channel A1 of the trough. Fresh tips
    # from row B are used to avoid contaminating the reagent source.
    for i in range(num_samples):
        dest_well = destination_plate[f"A{i + 1}"]
        tip_well = tip_rack[f"B{i + 1}"]

        # Pick up a fresh tip for reagent handling
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_well)

        # Aspirate reagent from the first trough channel
        await lh.aspirate(reagent_trough["A1"], vols=[reagent_volume])

        # Dispense reagent into the destination well
        await lh.dispense(dest_well, vols=[reagent_volume])

        # Mix to ensure sample and reagent are well combined
        await lh.mix(dest_well, vols=[mix_volume], repeats=3)

        # Return the used tip to the rack
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_well)

    # =========================================================
    # Protocol complete
    # =========================================================
    print(f"Transferred {num_samples} samples ({sample_volume} uL each) "
          f"and added {reagent_volume} uL reagent per well.")
    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
